subject.title: [Feature]: Skip dispatch when message mentions a different account's bot

question: Should Matrix add a default-off policy that skips dispatch when a human room message explicitly mentions another configured Matrix account, and what config shape should own that behavior?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding message-suppression semantics and new Matrix config surface is compatibility-sensitive product/API work under repository policy.

options.title: Add Matrix ignoreOtherMentions
options.body: Add a Matrix-owned per-room or account boolean aligned with Slack/Discord semantics that drops other-account explicit mentions before typing and dispatch while defaulting to current behavior.

options.title: Extend requireMention Semantics
options.body: Use an exclusive requireMention mode instead of a new boolean, accepting migration and docs complexity for a currently boolean contract.

options.title: Defer To Broader Participation
options.body: Keep the issue open until outbound sibling mention rendering or a broader Matrix participation design settles target-account detection and room participation semantics.

recommendation.title: Add Matrix ignoreOtherMentions
recommendation.body: Add a Matrix-owned per-room or account boolean aligned with Slack/Discord semantics that drops other-account explicit mentions before typing and dispatch while defaulting to current behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: gumadeiras has the strongest feature-history signal for Matrix allowBots and adjacent mention handling, which are the likely policy and implementation base for this decision.
